# CRISPR Editing Of 3 Genes Extends Lifespan In Mice: A Landmark Study Of Aging In 2024 By Our Group

We edited 3 genes in 40 mice with CRISPR and they lived 20% longer [1]. This is a novel, cutting-edge result.

## A subheading that is much longer than forty characters allows

Mice lived 12000 days in total at 37°C. Figure 1 and Fig 2 show this; Supplementary Fig. 1 has more, and Extended Data Figure 3 too. See [2,3].
